# Research Knowledge Base

This knowledge base contains selected public notes from the Academic ResearchOS.

The underlying research workspace is maintained locally in Obsidian. Only notes explicitly approved for publication are exported to this website.

## Knowledge Areas

### [Literature](literature.qmd)

Structured notes on scientific literature, including research questions, datasets, methods, experiments, results, innovations, limitations, and relevance to ongoing research.

### [Projects](projects.qmd)

Research projects and publication projects, including objectives, research questions, methods, milestones, current status, and planned outputs.

### [Ideas](ideas.qmd)

Research ideas under development, including hypotheses, possible methods, required data, related literature, and potential experiments.

### [Methods](methods.qmd)

Methodological notes covering InSAR, SBAS, DS-InSAR, atmospheric correction, GNSS, statistics, validation, and related analytical approaches.

### [Experiments](experiments.qmd)

Structured experimental records documenting objectives, hypotheses, datasets, methods, parameters, results, validation, interpretation, and reproducibility.

### [Publications](publications.qmd)

Research outputs and manuscripts from initial concept through analysis, writing, submission, revision, acceptance, and publication.

---

## ResearchOS Publishing Model

The public knowledge base is generated through the following workflow:

**Obsidian → Public-note selection → Quarto → Git → GitHub → GitHub Pages**

Only selected material from the private ResearchOS Vault is included here.
